nora-peopleops: Quick update 1 1 we're publishing editorial clarifications to PTO, parental leave examples, and expense receipt guidance. NO eligibility or accrual changes. Managers: please finish the 15m micro-training and submit ack via the manager CSV by 2026-09-10. Diff + notes: https://internal.redwood/handbook/sep-2026 :memo:

leo-hr: Thanks Nora. Can you confirm this doesn't change carryover rules or auto-accrual?

nora-peopleops: Confirmed 1 editorial only. We added examples and clarified acceptable receipt formats (PDF, emailed invoice, screenshot with vendor+date).

ash-engmgr: Can we get a short copy I can paste into team channels? Also need to add one lead manually 1 new manager mapping didn't flow yet.

nora-peopleops: Use this template: "Heads-up: handbook wording clarified for PTO & expenses (no policy changes). Managers complete 15m training by Sep 10: <training link>. Reach out with questions." For manual adds, send CSV (name,email,team) to hr-ops@redwood and we'll merge.

mia-ic: Completed training 70

training-bot: Reminder scheduled 1 3-day and 1-day nudges before Sep 10. Training: https://training.redwood/handbook-sep-2026 (15m).

nora-peopleops: Thanks all 1 I'll post the ack tracker after the audit and run a Q&A drop-in next Tue 10am PT. Flag any wording that looks substantive here.
